task.title: Ensuring the reason for separation (RFS) details are correct

step.cmd: In RCM, review block 12 and the Additional information field of the ROE and determine if there are comments related to the RFS:
Determine if the ROE requires any of the following changes:

ul.li: If the ROE requires a change to A - End of fishing , go to step 9.
If the ROE does not require changes, go to step 11.

step.cmd: In NWS, determine if there is a ROD on file for the period of employment indicating that the RFS is other than shortage of work or end of fishing (e.g. labour dispute, voluntary leaving):
In NWS, on the Resolve Issue tab of the ROE RFS Action WI, complete the Resolve Issue section as follows:

ul.li: Do the Reason for Separation details need to be modified?: Select Yes and select A - End of fishing .

step.cmd: In NWS, on the Resolve Issue tab of the ROE RFS Action WI, complete the Resolve Issue section as follows:

ul.li: Do the Reason for Separation details need to be modified?: Select No .
